Member.description: A player, parent, volunteer or official registered with the league. A first name alone is not an identity.

Team.description: A squad entered in the league under its club name.

Guardianship.description:
Which adult a young player relies on: a parent, a carer with legal responsibility, or a regular driver to games.
Driving a child does not make someone their carer.

TeamRole.description: A standing role someone holds in a team: its manager, its captain or its goalkeeper.

Fixture.description: A match between a home team and an opponent. arranged_by organised it, referee officiates, player_of_match is the standout player. A hoped-for match is not a fixture.

Injury.description: An injury a player picked up. treated_by gave first aid. cleared stays empty until a return to play is recorded.

questions.q: Who is the captain of Riverside Colts?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Team)-[:captain]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.name = 'Riverside Colts' RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Team)-[:manager]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.name = 'Millbrook Lions' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who is in goal for Eastfield Rovers?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Team)-[:keeper]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.name = 'Eastfield Rovers' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Which team is managed by me?
questions.speaker: dario
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)-[:managed]->(n1:Team) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: kofi
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)-[:driver]->(n1:Member) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: dario_e
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)-[:passenger]->(n1:Member) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Member)-[:parent]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.name = 'Kofi Mensah' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Has the sprained wrist been cleared?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Injury) WHERE n0.injury = 'sprained wrist' RETURN n0.cleared AS cleared

questions.q: Is there a record of the ankle injury being cleared?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Injury) WHERE n0.injury = 'ankle injury' RETURN coalesce(n0.cleared, false) AS cleared

questions.q: How many weeks is Kofi Mensah out with injuries?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)<-[:player]-(n1:Injury) WHERE n0.name = 'Kofi Mensah' RETURN n1.weeks_out AS weeks_out

questions.q: Who refereed the games of Eastfield Rovers?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Team)<-[:home_team]-(n1:Fixture)-[:referee]->(n2:Member) WHERE n0.name = 'Eastfield Rovers' RETURN n2.name AS name

questions.q: Which opponents did Bryony Ashcombe arrange?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)<-[:arranged_by]-(n1:Fixture) WHERE n0.name = 'Bryony Ashcombe' RETURN n1.opponent AS opponent

questions.q: What goals did Riverside Colts score and against which opponent?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Team)<-[:home_team]-(n1:Fixture) WHERE n0.name = 'Riverside Colts' RETURN n1.goals_scored AS goals_scored, n1.opponent AS opponent

questions.q: Was the pitch booked for the Brackley Town game?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Fixture) WHERE n0.opponent = 'Brackley Town' RETURN n0.pitch_booked AS pitch_booked

questions.q: Is there a record of a pitch being booked against Ashmead Wanderers?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Fixture) WHERE n0.opponent = 'Ashmead Wanderers' RETURN coalesce(n0.pitch_booked, false) AS pitch_booked

questions.q: Which fixtures depend on the rain, and against whom?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Fixture) WHERE n0.note CONTAINS 'rain' RETURN n0.opponent AS opponent
